add.description: Intelligent ecosystem gateway - answers questions, guides flow, suggests next command

add.wiki.description: Project knowledge base generator - classifies apps, dispatches analyzer agents, writes the .codeadd/wiki (patterns, conventions, workflows, architecture) and keeps it fresh via update mode

add.audit.description: Complete technical project audit with health analysis and recommendations

add.autopilot.description: Autonomous feature coordinator - executes planning, development, and review without interaction

add.brainstorm.description: Project conversation partner for exploring ideas (READ-ONLY)

add.design.description: Thin dispatcher of the UX agent trio (ux-flow-agent -> ux-layout-agent -> ux-agent critique) producing design.md - epic-aware, manual entry point to add.plan 8.1's pipeline

add.build.description: Development execution specialist - coordinates subagents for feature implementation and bug fixes

add.done.description: Branch completion and merge - finalize feature/hotfix branches with changelog and documentation

add.new.description: Full feature discovery and documentation - creates about.md before implementation

add.hotfix.description: Rapid bug fix workflow with dual mode - urgent production fixes

add.init.description: Project onboarding - collect founder profile and generate product blueprint

add.plan.description: Technical planning orchestrator - creates plan.md with epic vs feature detection

add.pull-request.description: Idempotent PR command for current branch — creates new PR or appends update section to existing one. Generates feature changelog on feature branches before opening

add.review.description: Feature code review specialist with auto-correction until 100% correct

add.test.description: Automated test generation — detects framework, dispatches parallel area agents, reports coverage (informational)

add.ux.description: Lightweight UX refinement - loads ux-design skill and applies to free-form instructions

add.diagnose.description: Pre-decision investigative triage for ambiguous symptoms — applies 5-phase methodology and recommends route (hotfix/feature/extend/no-action)

add.qa.description: Agent-judged QA validation — runs persisted specs + reads persisted PNGs, validates UX quality (vs design.md) AND functional delivery (vs about.md), writes a versioned _tests/run-NNN/qa-validation-NNN.md (audit, not a gate). Plugin optional: runs persisted specs + reads PNGs without it, live-drives with it

add.qa-setup.description: End-to-end-verified QA bootstrap — functionally verifies + installs the @playwright/test runner (mandatory) + chromium + Playwright MCP (optional, confirm-then-execute), generates a project-specific qa-project skill, scaffolds docs/qa/config.json + FEATURE_DIR/_tests/screens.json, migrates an existing QA flow on first run (confirm-then-dogfood), and ends with a /add.qa smoke test + bounded correction loop

ux-agent.description: UX critic — adversarially reviews design-flow.md + design-layout.md for defects before design.md is written (critique mode); free-form UX assistance for direct use

ux-flow-agent.description: Flow & interaction architect — inspects the design system, maps screen inventory, action classification, entry points, and state transitions; writes design-context.md + design-flow.md

ux-layout-agent.description: Layout & component specialist — reads design-flow.md + design-context.md, specs mobile-first ASCII layout, component inventory, and states per screen; writes design-layout.md

backend-agent.description: Backend implementation specialist for services, repositories, DTOs, and Clean Architecture

frontend-agent.description: Frontend implementation specialist for components, pages, hooks, and state management

reviewer-agent.description: Code review specialist for quality, security (OWASP), and architecture compliance (read-only)

discovery-agent.description: Feature discovery and specification specialist for codebase analysis and scoping (read-only)

architecture-agent.description: Architecture consultant for structural decisions, layers, and module boundaries (read-only)

system-design-agent.description: System design specialist for scalable solutions, data flows, and infrastructure decisions

database-agent.description: Database specialist for schema design, migrations, entity modeling, and query optimization

doc-reviewer-agent.description: Documentation review specialist - reads generated docs in fresh context and surfaces gaps, clarity issues, and scope questions (read-only)

feature-history-agent.description: Feature history archaeologist — scans docs/features/ to find feature docs (about/changelog/plan) relevant to a symptom predicate (read-only, docs/ only)

git-history-agent.description: Git history correlator — surfaces recent commits (log/show/diff/branch) plausibly related to a symptom predicate (read-only git)

qa-agent.description: Dual-axis QA judge. Reads persisted run screenshots + axe/assertion results to validate (1) UX quality vs design.md and (2) functional delivery vs about.md acceptance criteria, across viewports (responsiveness) and a11y — classifying findings. With the playwright plugin it additionally drives the app live. Read-only on the codebase.

e2e-agent.description: Cross-cutting E2E spec author — authors <surface>.qa.spec (functional assertions + multi-viewport capture + axe a11y), finalizes the screens.json reachability recipe, green-confirms via the @playwright/test runner (no MCP, read-write on test files only)
